title: P.2 RUN
status: Act I milestone M3 (Nov 19 2026). Script v1.0 MISSION P.2 Run, the Act I breakdown (P.2 Run row, A1 glass_row_edge) and P.1 v2 (the voice hops between Glass Row's screens; ??? header stays). Fail rule is the breakdown's proposal: caught by the net -> short fade -> restart at the last checkpoint, no lives.

zero_time.note: Time-based Zero Score (lower wins). Zero's time is set from the first escape: the next whole 5 s below it (never under min_s). Stored in the mission record as milliseconds (best_score / zero_score).

checkpoints.text: Out through the gap in the east fence
The van blocks the alley: dock or ramp
Across the plaza. The stairs at the far end
Across the Yard to the arcade's side door

start: {name}. Nice name. Sounds like a typo. PUSH.
East fence. Behind the dumpster. There's a gap.
fork: I'm borrowing this. It has eleven cents of battery. Hurry.
plaza: Drones scan faces, not backs. Stop turning around.
kiosk: Comfort mist is available to Silver tier and above.
stairs: Left. The drain grate under the stairs is loose.
caught: Gotcha! Let's get you somewhere comfortable.
culvert: He drops through the loose grate and pushes through the dry culvert that runs under the Yard's corner.
door: He reaches the arcade's side door. The chain falls away. Something inside has unlocked it.
zero_time_set: {time}. Not bad for a typo. That's the number now.
zero_time_beaten: {time}. Fine. Faster than me. Inside. Now.

drones: You're doing great! Please slow down so we can help you.
Running is a sign of stress. We can help with stress!
fony_land: (landing a big drop) Okay that was sick, okay, keep going.

end_card:
END OF THE PLAYABLE PROLOGUE

Next: MISSION P.3 POWER ON
